summary: Edit: enc3.h4 scaled x2 and cross.h1 scaled x0.5 (2 heads). Passes the validation rule (500 seeds: 67 fixed, 21 broken, share of failures removed 0.517, p 9.2e-07, strict gain +9.4 points). The stop rule was not needed.

Chosen by the rule committed in awe/candidates.py before any validation rollout. r6 (3 heads) had the larger validation gain (+10.4 against +9.2 points), r4 the larger pooled design plus validation net (152 against 150). Candidates are not distinguishable from each other.

The written hypothesis (verbatim from hypotheses.md) is not supported by the files and edit.json says so next to it: median reach error rose, the head atlas shows enc3.h4 carries almost no cube-position signal (rank 36 of 48) and cross.h1, which the edit halves, is the second strongest cube reader, and the fixes are spread over failure kinds. The edit breaks the low corner of the square (post hoc zone).

The auto-greedy edit (enc0.h1 x0 and enc3.h4 x2) IS agent candidate r2, op for op. The agent wrote r2 by hand in the refinement round. Design, 1,000 seeds: 121 fixed, 22 broken, +9.9 points (the 450 search seeds are inside: 48 fixed, 8 broken). Validation, 500 seeds: 61 fixed, 23 broken, +7.6 points. Both were known before the search script was rewritten to the version that ran (a58d08c). The earlier version (da0c746, never run) had to contain cross.h1.x0 and could not have returned this pair. A second pair of the 15, c07 (cross.h3 x2 and enc0.h1 x0), had also been run by the agent. The arm is not an edit the agent never saw and not an independent no-LLM result, and the report must not describe it as either. It shares the head enc3.h4 x2 with the agent's edit and is about as strong on its own search seeds (net +40 against +43 for r4, selected numbers). See relation_to_agent_candidates in freeze/autogreedy.json and DEVIATIONS.md.

The random-edit rule and seed were committed (5d457b4) before any random edit ran. Every arm ran on 3 design seeds from this tree and the arms with earlier rows reproduced their trajectory hashes (stage3/smoke_compare.json).
Validation checks used: 8 of 10. Budgets: agent 95,057 of 100,000, baselines 46,800 of 50,000, autogreedy 8,550 of 10,000.

Limits added after freeze review g2.1 round 1: the constant-offset baseline sits at the smallest step of its grid (0.01 rad on joint 9) and was not refined the way the gain was (-0.02 is worse on 1,000 design seeds, +2.0 against +3.3 points). dose_k2 and dose_k3 both have cross.h1 at x0 (clipped) and differ only in enc3.h4 (x3 against x4). The head atlas existed when the r4 hypothesis line was written, so the line contradicted data on hand.
